text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Copano Rickey ran a brilliant race by 
applying feng shui. Yet Hokko Tarumae 
shows open frustration, precisely because 
she acknowledges her rival's true ability.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She wanted to face a Copano Rickey who 
focused entirely on racing from start to 
finish, without relying on feng shui. 
Precisely because both are so earnest, 
finding common ground is no easy task.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Copano Rickey vows to face Hokko Tarumae 
again at the "February Stakes," wanting to 
clash and truly earn each other's respect.
